faqLeft.q: What engine does the Defender 300Tdi use?
faqLeft.a: The Defender 300Tdi uses the 300Tdi — a 2.5-litre inline-four diesel engine, fitted to classic Defender 90, 110 and 130 models from approximately 1994 to 2007.

faqLeft.q: How much does a Defender 300Tdi engine rebuild cost?
faqLeft.a: Rebuilds start from £1,900. Exact price depends on condition and parts required — submit your reg for a fixed-price quote.

faqLeft.q: Which engine code is fitted to my Defender?
faqLeft.a: Enter your registration on this page and we'll confirm whether you have the 200Tdi, 300Tdi or Td5 before you're quoted anything.
Yes. We replace the timing belt and inspect the cylinder head and cooling system as standard on every 300Tdi rebuild, along with injectors and gaskets where needed.

faqRight.q: Do you supply used Defender 300Tdi engines?
faqRight.a: Yes, in some cases a matched low-mileage used engine is the right option. Our team will advise honestly once we've matched your registration and understood your situation.

faqRight.q: Can you recover my Defender if the engine has failed?
faqRight.a: Yes — nationwide recovery is available from £70, and most vehicles are collected within a few hours of booking.

faqRight.q: How long does a Defender 300Tdi engine rebuild take?
faqRight.a: Most rebuilds are completed within 3-5 working days from the time your car arrives at our workshop.

faqRight.q: Is rebuilding better than fitting a used engine?
faqRight.a: For most Defender 300Tdi owners, yes. A rebuild removes the compatibility risk that comes with an unknown used unit's history, and comes with a 12-month unlimited-mileage warranty — often longer and more comprehensive than what a used engine supplier offers.
